record.bible_text: And David<WH01732> said<WH0559><WTH8799> in his heart<WH03820>, I shall now perish<WH05595><WTH8735> one<WH0259> day<WH03117> by the hand<WH03027> of Saul<WH07586>: <FI>there is<Fi> nothing better<WH02896> for me than that<WH03588> I should speedily<WH04422><WTH8736> escape<WH04422><WTH8735> into the land<WH0776> of the Philistines<WH06430>; and Saul<WH07586> shall despair<WH02976><WTH8738> of me, to seek<WH01245><WTH8763> me any more in any coast<WH01366> of Israel<WH03478>: so shall I escape<WH04422><WTH8738> out of his hand<WH03027>. <RF>perish: Heb. be consumed<Rf>

And David<WH01732> arose<WH06965><WTH8799>, and he passed over<WH05674><WTH8799> with the six<WH08337> hundred<WH03967> men<WH0376> that <FI>were<Fi> with him unto Achish<WH0397>, the son<WH01121> of Maoch<WH04582>, king<WH04428> of Gath<WH01661>.

And David<WH01732> dwelt<WH03427><WTH8799> with Achish<WH0397> at Gath<WH01661>, he and his men<WH0582>, every man<WH0376> with his household<WH01004>, <FI>even<Fi> David<WH01732> with his two<WH08147> wives<WH0802>, Ahinoam<WH0293> the Jezreelitess<WH03159>, and Abigail<WH026> the Carmelitess<WH03762>, Nabal's<WH05037> wife<WH0802>.

And it was told<WH05046><WTH8714> Saul<WH07586> that David<WH01732> was fled<WH01272><WTH8804> to Gath<WH01661>: and he sought<WH01245><WTH8763> no more again<WH03254><WTH8804><WTH8675><WH03254><WTH8686> for him.

And David<WH01732> said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto Achish<WH0397>, If I have now found<WH04672><WTH8804> grace<WH02580> in thine eyes<WH05869>, let them give<WH05414><WTH8799> me a place<WH04725> in some<WH0259> town<WH05892> in the country<WH07704>, that I may dwell<WH03427><WTH8799> there: for why should thy servant<WH05650> dwell<WH03427><WTH8799> in the royal<WH04467> city<WH05892> with thee?
Then Achish<WH0397> gave<WH05414><WTH8799> him Ziklag<WH06860> that day<WH03117>: wherefore Ziklag<WH06860> pertaineth unto the kings<WH04428> of Judah<WH03063> unto this day<WH03117>.

And the time<WH04557><WH03117> that David<WH01732> dwelt<WH03427><WTH8804> in the country<WH07704> of the Philistines<WH06430> was a full year<WH03117> and four<WH0702> months<WH02320>. <RF>the time: Heb. the number of days<Rf> <RF>a full year: Heb. a year of days<Rf><CM>

And David<WH01732> and his men<WH0582> went up<WH05927><WTH8799>, and invaded<WH06584><WTH8799> the Geshurites<WH01651>, and the Gezrites<WH01511>, and the Amalekites<WH06003>: for those<WH02007> <FI>nations were<Fi> of old<WH05769> the inhabitants<WH03427><WTH8802> of the land<WH0776>, as thou goest<WH0935><WTH8800> to Shur<WH07793>, even unto the land<WH0776> of Egypt<WH04714>. <RF>Gezrites: or, Gerzites<Rf>

And David<WH01732> smote<WH05221><WTH8689> the land<WH0776>, and left neither man<WH0376> nor woman<WH0802> alive<WH02421><WTH8762>, and took away<WH03947><WTH8804> the sheep<WH06629>, and the oxen<WH01241>, and the asses<WH02543>, and the camels<WH01581>, and the apparel<WH0899>, and returned<WH07725><WTH8799>, and came<WH0935><WTH8799> to Achish<WH0397>.

And Achish<WH0397> said<WH0559><WTH8799>, Whither<WH0408> have ye made a road<WH06584><WTH8804> to day<WH03117>? And David<WH01732> said<WH0559><WTH8799>, Against the south<WH05045> of Judah<WH03063>, and against the south<WH05045> of the Jerahmeelites<WH03397>, and against the south<WH05045> of the Kenites<WH07017>. <RF>Whither...: or, Did you not make a road, etc<Rf>

And David<WH01732> saved<WH02421><WTH8762> neither man<WH0376> nor woman<WH0802> alive<WH02421><WTH8762>, to bring<WH0935><WTH8687> <FI>tidings<Fi> to Gath<WH01661>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, Lest they should tell<WH05046><WTH8686> on us, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, So did<WH06213><WTH8804> David<WH01732>, and so <FI>will be<Fi> his manner<WH04941> all the while<WH03117> he dwelleth<WH03427><WTH8804> in the country<WH07704> of the Philistines<WH06430>.

And Achish<WH0397> believed<WH0539><WTH8686> David<WH01732>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, He hath made his people<WH05971> Israel<WH03478> utterly<WH0887><WTH8687> to abhor<WH0887><WTH8689> him; therefore he shall be my servant<WH05650> for ever<WH05769>. <RF>utterly...: Heb. to stink<Rf><CM>
